t: This is the Devas Club for Young People, a youth club in Battersea, south London. It offers sporting, educational and creative opportunities to disadvantaged young people. The club was founded by Jocelyn Devas, a British philanthropist who lived from 1859 to 1885, and it carries the family name to this day. Devas died young, at about twenty-six, but the club she began is still working for young people in Battersea.
